comment: The one ecosystem result that is not a parse: a multi-sample signal track
read as N BigWigs against the same values packed into one chunked array.
It is network-bound rather than CPU-bound, so it has no place in the
in-process vitest matrix and is measured by its own harness:
in GMOD/jbrowse-components, which counts every request and byte by wrapping
fetch. Paste its output here; report.ts carries these numbers into the
generated LaTeX so the paper never holds a hand-typed copy of them.
